Fridman și Usmanov au fost scoși de pe listă sub presiunea Franței și a Slovaciei, în cadrul unui compromis diplomatic de mare miză care a prelungit sancțiunile UE împotriva a aproximativ 3.000 de persoane și entități rusești de la reînnoirea standard de șase luni la o perioadă de trei ani, relatează Kyiv Post.

estonia.title: Mark Rutte dă asigurări că NATO este pregătită să facă faţă atacurilor hibride ale Moscovei. „Rusia îşi intensifică acţiunile”
estonia.description: NATO este „pregătită” să facă faţă atacurilor cibernetice ruseşti şi altor forme de război hibrid, a declarat joi secretarul general al Alianţei Nord-Atlantice, Mark Rutte. El a cerut un sprijin sporit pentru Ucraina ca răspuns la acţiunile Moscovei.

estonia.title: Raport: Rusia ar putea ataca o țară NATO în următoarele luni, avertizează serviciile secrete daneze
estonia.description: Rusia ar putea desfășura în lunile următoare o operațiune militară limitată împotriva uneia dintre țările NATO, a declarat Serviciul de Informații și Securitate Militară (DDIS) al Danemarcei.

estonia.title: „Reacționează doar la forță”. Avertismentul dur al premierului Republicii Moldova, Vasile Tofan, privind acțiunile lui Putin
estonia.description: Premierul Republicii Moldova, Vasile Tofan, a dezvăluit, într-un interviu pentru CNN, care este „secretul” care a făcut ca ţara sa să reziste intenselor încercări de destabilizare din partea Rusiei, avertizând totodată că Europa trebuie să fie pregătită să se confrunte cu şi mai multă propagandă din partea Moscovei, care face posibilă victoria unor partide extremiste în ţări cu democraţii consolidate. În legătură cu survolul dronelor, el a spus că nu consideră că există o ameninţare iminentă pentru Moldova în ceea ce priveşte o potenţială incursiune, fiind de părere că Rusia mai degrabă testează ţările NATO. Rusia nu reacţionează la slăbiciune, ci reacţionează doar la forţă, a avertizat şeful guvernului de la Chişinău.

estonia.title: Ce spune Predoiu despre propunerea unei Poliții unice: „Urez succes în discuţiile cu organizaţiile asociative ale primarilor din ţară”
estonia.description: Ministrul interimar de Interne, senatorul Cătălin Predoiu, declară joi că, dacă ajunge în Parlament, va vota Guvernul Siegfried Mureşan, el arătând că este nevoie urgentă de un guvern pro-occidental cu puteri depline.

estonia.title: Olanda anunţă prelungirea operațiunilor de Poliție Aeriană. Dronele MQ-9 Reaper vor rămâne în România până la 31 decembrie 2027
estonia.description: Olanda prelungeşte din nou desfăşurarea dronelor sale MQ-9 Reaper care operează din Câmpia Turzii, în România, anunţă, joi, Ambasada Olandei în România. Avioanele fără pilot vor contribui acum la apărarea Flancului Estic al NATO până la 31 decembrie 2027.

estonia.title: „Rusia a pierdut deja războiul din Ucraina”, susține președintele unei țări NATO și UE
estonia.description: Rusia „a pierdut deja” războiul împotriva Ucrainei, a afirmat președintele lituanian Gitanas Nausėda, invocând costurile militare „enorme” suportate de Moscova.

estonia.title: Avioane de vânătoare poloneze, ridicate pentru a intercepta un aparat de spionaj rus Il-20, în largul coastei Mării Baltice
estonia.description: Avioanele de vânătoare poloneze au interceptat marți un avion de spionaj rus în largul coastei poloneze a Mării Baltice, a declarat ministrul Apărării, Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz.

estonia.title: Ce prevede acordul istoric privind Groenlanda: noi baze militare, reguli pentru investiții și promisiuni pentru NATO
estonia.description: Statele Unite, Danemarca și Groenlanda au semnat, marți, un acord de securitate menit să pună capăt lunilor de tensiuni privind teritoriul danez autonom, după amenințările repetate ale președintelui american Donald Trump de a prelua controlul asupra vastei insule arctice. Reuters a prezentat câteva componente cheie ale acordului, care se adaugă unui pact americano-danez din 1951 privind apărarea Groenlandei, conform unui text publicat de Guvernul danez.

estonia.title: Nicușor Dan, la CNN: Nu e foarte probabil ca Rusia să atace o țară NATO în următorii unu-doi ani, dar trebuie să fim pregătiți
estonia.description: Preşedintele Nicuşor Dan, aflat la New York pentru cea de-a 81-a sesiune a Adunării Generale a Organizaţiei Naţiunilor Unite, a declarat că „nu este foarte probabil” ca Rusia să atace o ţară NATO „în următorii unu-doi ani”, dar România trebuie să fie pregătită. De asemenea, şeful statului nu crede că Rusia este cu adevărat pregătită să pună capăt războiului şi apreciază că preşedintele Donald Trump „are dreptate” că Europa trebuie să se implice mai mult în propria apărare.

estonia.title: NATO învață în țările baltice cum să poarte un război în epoca dronelor: De ce „un tanc pe câmpul de luptă este acum ca un tort”
estonia.description: În țările baltice, forțele NATO încearcă zilele acestea să învețe noul mod de a face război, folosindu-se de lecțiile de pe frontul ucrainean, iar militarii văd cum doctrina militară tradițională a devenit învechită și neadecvată.

estonia.title: Marine Le Pen introduce o nuanță în poziția sa anti-NATO. „Dar, desigur, dorința mea de a face acest lucru rămâne”
estonia.description: Marine Le Pen, candidată la alegerile prezidențiale de anul viitor, a declarat pentru Politico că își dorește în continuare ieșirea Franței din structura de comandă integrată a NATO, dar că acest lucru nu trebuie să se întâmple cât încă este în desfășurare războiul din Ucraina. „Atât timp cât există un război la porțile Europei, acesta …

estonia.title: Gestul pe care spune Peiu că îl așteaptă AUR de la PSD pentru a negocia o majoritate, „după căderea previzibilă a guvernului Mureșan”
estonia.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrișor Peiu, a reiterat că parlamentarii partidului său nu vor susține învestirea guvernului Mureșan și „cel mai probabil” vor părăsi sala la eventualul vot din Parlament. Peiu a declarat, joi seară, la Antena 3, că AUR nu exclude posibilitatea de a negocia cu PSD „după căderea previzibilă a guvernului Mureșan”, cu condiția …

estonia.title: Generalul care conduce NATO spune deschis că, în prezent, „suntem cu toții țări de pe flancul estic” și îl avertizează pe Putin: „Să nu încerce cât sunt eu la comandă”
estonia.description: Țările NATO intensifică schimbul din domeniul intelligence-ului ca răspuns la valul de sabotaje și alte incidente aparent legate de Rusia, dar alianța ar trebui să fie „calmă și încrezătoare” că poate face față oricărei amenințări reprezentate de Moscova, a spus joi comandantul de top al organizației militare internaționale. Declarațiile generalului Alexus Grynkewich, din cadrul Forțelor …

estonia.title: Trans activists accuse state gender committee of bias and obstruction
estonia.description: Trans activists in Estonia have accused the state gender reassignment committee of obstruction and bias, and are demanding that the committee's chair be removed.

estonia.title: State Real Estate Ltd. puts former Tallinn Music High School properties up for auction
estonia.description: State Real Estate Ltd. (RKAS) has announced a public online auction for properties in Tallinn's Nõmme district that housed Tallinn Music High School from 1961 to 2022. The starting price is €6.09 million.

estonia.title: Trust in the president and the Defense Forces has declined
estonia.description: According to public‑opinion monitoring commissioned by the Government Office, Estonia's most trusted institutions remain the police and the president.

estonia.title: Ukrainian 'ethno-chaos' band DakhaBrakha back in Tallinn this December
estonia.description: On December 5, Ukrainian world music quartet DakhaBrakha returns to Tallinn, bringing its signature "ethno-chaos" sound and latest album, "Ptakh," to Paavli Culture Factory.

estonia.title: Alar Karis: UN Charter principles must not be trampled underfoot
estonia.description: At this difficult junction, the UN needs a strong and principled leader with an impeccable record of defending and advancing international law, human rights and the principles of the UN Charter. Estonia believes that after 81 years, it is time for a woman to lead the UN, President Alar Karis said in Estonia's national statement at the 81st session of the UN General Assembly.

estonia.title: Rail Baltica delays leave local communities disappointed
estonia.description: Businesses and residents in the settlements along the planned Tallinn–Pärnu section of Rail Baltica are disappointed, as the state is once again breaking its promise and the completion of the new railway may be delayed by up to eight years.

estonia.title: Municipalities look to libraries to get kids reading
estonia.description: Estonian municipalities want to get kids reading more. One option may be for school and public libraries to team up more, making it easier for children to access books.

estonia.title: Chaplain hotline returns as demand for emotional support remains high
estonia.description: Demand for emotional support by phone and online remains high in Estonia, prompting the relaunch of a chaplain hotline first launched at the start of the COVID-19 pandemic.

estonia.title: Investor: Baltic defense forces cool on domestic drones
estonia.description: There are too few drone developers in the Baltic states, partly as some local defense forces are cool towards domestic products, according to an investor in the sector.

estonia.title: Australian soccer player of Estonian origin now oldest in the UEFA Champions League
estonia.description: Estonian-born Australian defender Aivi Luik became the oldest player to appear in the Women's Champions League league phase on Tuesday.

estonia.title: Cultural workers minimum wage will not rise but salary fund grows by €2.9 million
estonia.description: The wage fund for cultural workers will increase by nearly €3 million next year, but the minimum wage will not rise, Minister of Culture Heidy Purga (Reform) said at the government's press conference.

estonia.title: Justice chancellor urges balance between security powers and rights protections
estonia.description: Chancellor of Justice Ülle Madise says that when granting security agencies the powers needed in a difficult security situation, strong and substantive oversight must be ensured so that security is not guaranteed at the expense of fundamental rights.

estonia.title: Funding shortfall stalls plan to turn Narva church into concert hall
estonia.description: The conversion of Narva's Alexander's Cathedral into a concert hall has come to a standstill because of insufficient funding. The Narva city government sees a possible solution in partially renovating the church, but for that the state would need to find more than three million euros.

estonia.title: Gallery: Students gather in Tartu to demand a more effective support system
estonia.description: Students gathered in Tallinn and Tartu on Thursday for a protest titled "Estonia's Future Burning Out" to draw attention to shortcomings in the student support system. Several hundred people took part in the protest in Tartu.

estonia.title: Eesti Energia CEO: Data centers benefit the power system
estonia.description: Eesti Energia CEO Andrus Durejko told ERR that data centers help balance the energy system. In his assessment, Estonia will not introduce nuclear energy before 2040.

estonia.title: Gallery: Architecture museum opens landscape‑architecture exhibit
estonia.description: The Estonian Museum of Architecture on Wednesday opened its renewed outdoor area with the landscape‑architecture exhibition "Not set in stone: Glimpses of Estonian Landscape Architecture."

estonia.title: Expert: Ukraine has negotiations leverage for the first time
estonia.description: Security expert Rainer Saks told Vikerraadio that Ukraine has, for the first time, gained the ability to influence the course of negotiations to end the war in its dealings with both the United States and Russia.

estonia.title: Tallinn school asks ministry for €400,000 in emergency funds to finish out the year
estonia.description: The Tallinn School of Music and Ballet (MUBA) is seeking €379,702 in additional funding from the Ministry of Education and Research to cover a budget shortfall and complete this year's studies without interruption.

estonia.title: Energy communities need a clear purpose, less red tape
estonia.description: More and more energy communities are emerging in Estonia, following the example of Western Europe. Although they are also waiting for the chance to share their surplus electricity, each such cooperative must solve some local‑level problem, argue community leaders from Estonia and Sweden.

estonia.title: Housing prices rise 6% on year as market rebounds
estonia.description: Housing prices rose six percent year on year, Statistics Estonia data show, with market players saying prices and buyer interest are picking up after a downturn.

estonia.title: A bronze cabbage-head bust arrives at the National Library
estonia.description: On 23 September, the portrait bust "Monument to Books Worn to Shreds" was brought directly from the foundry to the inner courtyard of the Estonian National Library. The work was placed on a concrete pedestal and will await final finishing before its opening later this year.

estonia.title: Estonia's first resident ambassador to Azerbaijan presents credentials
estonia.description: Estonia's first resident ambassador to Azerbaijan, Tiina Nirk, presented her credentials to President Ilham Aliyev on Tuesday, the Foreign Ministry said.

estonia.title: Pärnu man shot dead by police after pointing 'gun' at officer
estonia.description: A Pärnu man has died after a Police and Border Guard Board (PPA) officer deployed his service weapon against him. The deceased had been brandishing what looked like a firearm.

estonia.title: Reform eyes 20 seats as it heads into elections with current PM
estonia.description: MP Liina Kersna (Reform Party) says the upcoming elections will be held with current Prime Minister Kristen Michal at the helm, and that a strong result for the party would be at least 20 seats.

estonia.title: Nuclear physicists: Plant would be Estonia's security guarantee
estonia.description: Estonia has no future alternative comparable to nuclear power, which would also provide a security guarantee, two nuclear physicists told ERR.

estonia.title: President at the UN: A turning point where the old is out and the new doesn't yet exist
estonia.description: According to President Alar Karis, the world is currently at a turning point where the existing international order no longer fully functions, but a new one has yet to emerge.

estonia.title: Tarmo Miilits: Russia shows no intent to attack a NATO country right now
estonia.description: Let's turn the fear temperature down, because we have no signs indicating that Russia currently intends to militarily attack any NATO ally, writes Tarmo Miilits.

estonia.title: Baltic states ask EU for €500 million in additional support for drone defense
estonia.description: The Baltic states have submitted a joint letter to the European Commission requesting €500 million in additional European Union funding to develop counter-drone capabilities.

estonia.title: Estonia imposes own sanctions on delisted Russian oligarch pair
estonia.description: Estonia has imposed its own domestic sanctions on two Russian oligarchs removed from a European Union blacklist this week.

estonia.title: Minister: Teachers, rescuers, police to get pay rises in 2027 budget
estonia.description: Teachers, cultural workers, rescuers and police will receive modest pay rises next year, Education Minister Kristina Kallas (Eesti 200) said as union talks resumed Wednesday.

estonia.title: Magnitude 1.4 quake shakes northwestern Estonia
estonia.description: A 1.4 magnitude earth tremor was recorded on Sunday, Maaleht reported, the second to be recorded in the region this year.

estonia.title: Swedish prisoners complaining of conditions in Tartu prison
estonia.description: Swedish offenders transferred to Tartu Prison have complained to Swedish media through their relatives about living conditions, including the soup served for dinner and having to eat from metal bowls, Postimees writes.

estonia.title: Saaremaa residents oppose Elering's planned Estonia–Latvia overhead power line
estonia.description: Many Saaremaa residents — as well as the Saaremaa municipal government — do not support Elering's plan to build a 330 kV Estonia–Latvia overhead power line across Saaremaa. Locals prefer an underground cable or a subsea cable running directly to Latvia.

estonia.title: Illegal immigration to Estonia rises, border rotation extended
estonia.description: Interior Minister Igor Taro (Eesti 200) says illegal immigration into Estonia has grown. Estonia is extending its border‑guard rotation on the Latvia–Belarus border.

estonia.title: Centuries-old water channels unearthed during construction in Tartu
estonia.description: Archaeologists excavating the site of Tartu's planned Siuru cultural center have uncovered centuries-old drainage channels in remarkably good condition.

estonia.title: EKRE politician hit with copyright claim after using Alo Mattiisen song in political ad
estonia.description: On June 8, a political ad posted on EKRE Vice Chair Mart Helme's Facebook page used Alo Mattiisen's song "Isamaa ilu hoieldes" without permission, prompting a damages claim.

estonia.title: Estonia's government sector deficit comes to €696 million in Q2
estonia.description: The budget deficit stood at 1.6 percent of GDP over the past four quarters, while public debt stood at 26.1 percent, Statistics Estonia said.

estonia.title: Hans Väre: Where is our AI kill switch?
estonia.description: If we have generators and drinking water supplies for power outages, Estonia should also have an ax with which to cut dangerous AI out of critical infrastructure, writes Hans Väre.

estonia.title: Üllar Lanno: So that treatment queues don't turn into death sentences
estonia.description: If the state tries to save money in healthcare by stretching waiting lists and cutting services, someone will eventually pay with their life. The next government will have little choice but to sharply expand medical training and close the funding gap, because the state is obligated to provide timely care, writes Üllar Lanno.

estonia.title: Gold dust and egg yolks behind Tallinn theater's luxurious interior decor
estonia.description: Gloria Palace opened in Tallinn in 1926 as a luxury movie theater promising an unprecedented experience. It survived the March 1944 bombing and remains largely intact.

estonia.title: Industry: Defense contractor funding could be more transparent
estonia.description: Estonia is spending €100 million a year on defense products for Ukraine, but the companies receiving the funding and the basis for selecting them remain unclear.

estonia.title: Estonia, Canada convene first Canada-NB8 ministerial meeting
estonia.description: Estonia and Canada convened the first Canada-Nordic-Baltic Eight (NB8) ministerial meeting in New York Tuesday, bringing together foreign ministers from eight countries.

estonia.title: PM addresses opposition's defense procurement criticism in public letter
estonia.description: In his response to the opposition, Kristen Michal writes that he learned of the problems with the artillery shell procurements from a National Audit Office report and then asked national defense heads to brief the Cabinet.

estonia.title: Bill would end monthly counseling requirement for many unemployed Estonians
estonia.description: Under a draft prepared at the Ministry of Economic Affairs, many people registered with the Unemployment Insurance Fund will no longer be required to attend counseling once a month, while young jobseekers and those with reduced work ability will face more frequent counseling.

estonia.title: Fox caught after second rescue call to Viru shopping center
estonia.description: Last Friday morning, the Emergency Response Center was once again notified that a fox was running around the third floor of the parking garage at the Viru shopping center in Tallinn.

estonia.title: Aune Valk: For the student who didn't make it to class
estonia.description: Too often, working long hours alongside studies — or deciding not to enroll in university at all — is a rational and sometimes the only possible choice for staying afloat, writes Aune Valk.

estonia.title: Minister: France must explain lifting sanctions on Russian oligarch
estonia.description: France should explain itself after it pushed for the lifting of EU sanctions on Russian-Uzbek billionaire Alisher Usmanov, Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna (Eesti 200) said Tuesday.

estonia.title: US to send new troop contingent to Estonia, ministry confirms
estonia.description: The United States will deploy a new military contingent to Estonia in the near future, Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna (Eesti 200) said Tuesday.

estonia.title: Estonia raises €373 million in short-term bonds
estonia.description: Estonia issued €373 million in short-term bonds on Tuesday, with six- and 12-month maturities yielding an average 2.91 percent and 3.209 percent, respectively.

estonia.title: Poll shows support for Isamaa and Center Party now level
estonia.description: In the latest poll, 22.8 percent of respondents backed Isamaa and 22 percent supported the Center Party, a Norstat survey shows.

estonia.title: Suurbritannia peaminister alustas jalgpallifännide diskrimineerimise lõpetamiseks võitlust
estonia.description: Suurbritannia peaminister Andy Burnham nimetas jalgpallimatšide ajal fännidele kehtestatud tribüünidel alkoholi joomise keelu diskrimineerimiseks.

estonia.title: TUNNED ÄRA? ⟩ Nende tähemärkide esindajatel on kõige raskem enda keskmes püsida
estonia.description: Inimesed, kelle sünnikaardis domineerib üks nendest sodiaagimärkidest, peavad nägema veidi rohkem vaeva, et leida elus oma keskpunkt ning tunda ära, mis valikud on hetkel õiged. Kas kuulud ka nende hulka?

estonia.title: PEALE PROOVI ⟩ Kuidas kohtuvad koolilapse hobid ja laulurõõm?
estonia.description: Septembrikuu tuules alustab «Peale proovi» uut hooaega väikeste lauljate seltsis! Räägime koolilaste hobidest, laulmisest ja sellest, kui palju tegemisi ühe lapse nädalasse tegelikult mahub. Saatejuht Ode Pürg vestleb lauluõpetaja ning väikeste lauljatega.

estonia.title: Kuusmaa: tüüpiline hooaja esimene mäng, mõlemalt poolt kõikuva kvaliteediga
estonia.description: Eesti-Läti korvpalliliiga avamängus alistas vinge lõpuspurdi teinud Tartu Ülikool Maks & Moorits Tallinna Bigbank/Kalevi 90:63. Peatreenerid Aivar Kuusmaa ja Brett Nõmm nentisid, et tööd tuleb teha veel maa ja ilm.

estonia.title: FOTOD ⟩ Brigitte Susanne Hunt tähistas sünnipäeva ja pidas beebipidu: sünnitama minnes teen soengu pähe ja võtan kaasa siidist linad
estonia.description: Täna saab 31-aastaseks Brigitte Susanne Hunt, kes tervitab peagi oma esiklast. Seekordne sünnipäevapidu toimus 24. septembri õhtul koos beebipeoga ja külalised tõidki kinke tulevasele ilmakodanikule. «Brigitte näeb nii hea välja, on suurepärases vormis ja särab, kuigi käimas on kolmas trimester,» ütleb Katrin Lust, kes samuti peol osales.

estonia.title: Eesti naiskond alistas maleolümpial suure ülekaaluga Lõuna-Aafrika Vabariigi
estonia.description: Eesti naiskond võitis Samarkandis jätkuval olümpial kaheksandas voorus Lõuna-Aafrika Vabariiki 4:0.

estonia.title: ANALÜÜS JA GALERII ⟩ Tartu näitas killukesi oma potentsiaalist, Kalevit ootab väga raske hooaeg
estonia.description: Eesti-Läti korvpalliliiga avalöök Maarjamaal on tehtud ning Tartu Ülikool Maks & Moorits alistas Tallinna Bigbank/Kalevi koguni 90:63. Hooaja avamängule kohaselt ei saa liiga suuri järeldusi teha, kuid üht-teist küll.

estonia.title: «TÄIELIK LIIALDUS!» ⟩ Harry ja Meghan panid lapsed uude kooli, osa lapsevanemaid juba marus
estonia.description: Prints Harry ja Meghan Markle’i laste koolitee Suurbritannias pole alanud just kõige rahulikumalt. Pärast seda, kui Archie ja Lilibet vaid kahe päeva järel esimesest koolist ära võeti, on nad nüüdseks leidnud uue õppeasutuse. Seal on aga lapsevanematele jagatud juhiseid, mida mõned seostavad otseselt Sussexitega, ning paljud pole uutest reeglitest sugugi vaimustuses.

estonia.title: USKUMATU VIDEO ⟩ Juba teine USA hävitaja kukkus viie päeva jooksul Saksamaal alla: piloot pääses üle noatera
estonia.description: Saksamaal Spangdahlemi õhuväebaasi lähistel kukkus teisipäeval alla USA õhujõudude hävitaja F-16 Fighting Falcon. Piloodil õnnestus lennukist katapulteeruda ning ta pääses õnnetusest kergemate vigastustega, vahendab Air & Space Forces Magazine.

estonia.title: PEETRI PILK ⟩ Marti Hääl: riik, mis jätab heaolu tagamiseks oma ressursid kasutamata, on läbikukkunud
estonia.description: Postimehe arvamustoimetuse ja Postimees TV autorisaates «Peetri pilk» analüüsib Peeter Koppel eelneva nädala uudiseid ja arutleb saatekülalisega aktuaalsetel teemadel.

estonia.title: JUHTKIRI ⟩ Lubati jõhkraid kärpeid, saime jõhkra defitsiidi
estonia.description: Järgmise aasta riigieelarve jääb suure tõenäosusega vähemasti lähiajal viimaseks, mida praegused valitsuserakonnad koostavad. Erakonna Eesti 200 juht Kristina Kallas ütles valitsuse pressikonverentsil, et kärbitud on kõike, mida kärpida annab, kuid eelarve on sellegipoolest suures miinuses.

latvia.title: France would defend eastern flank borders even outside NATO, says Mélenchon
latvia.description: The far-left presidential candidate also criticized Germany's rearmament in an interview with POLITICO.

latvia.title: Erdoğan tells UN that Europe cannot be safe without Turkey
latvia.description: Speaking at the UN General Assembly, Erdoğan argued that Turkey is an indispensable part of European security architecture. Turkey has been a NATO member since 1952 but its EU accession process has been frozen for nearly a decade.

latvia.title: Videóban kért bocsánatot az Országos Mentőszolgálat főigazgatója a félresikerült posztjuk után
latvia.description: Constantinovits Miklós szerint ez nem az az irány, amerre szeretnék, hogy a mentőszolgálat haladjon.

latvia.title: Brovdi: Putyin 300 ezer embert tervez mozgósítani és a frontra küldeni még az év vége előtt
latvia.description: A magyar származású ukrán drónparancsnok szerint mindig lesz egy Orbán, aki akadályozza a NATO működését.

latvia.title: Dán hírszerzés: Oroszország fokozni fogja a hibrid háborúját, egy NATO-tagállam elleni katonai támadás sem kizárt
latvia.description: Moszkva célja a NATO megosztása – állapította meg a dán hírszerzés jelentése.

latvia.title: A dán hírszerzés szerint Oroszország korlátozott támadást intézhet egy NATO-ország ellen hónapokon belül
latvia.description: A dán szolgálatok szerint Oroszország megpróbálhatja tesztelni a NATO 5. cikkelyét, ami a tagállamok kollektív védelmét írja elő.

latvia.title: Videóban kért bocsánatot az Országos Mentőszolgálat főigazgatója, miután a temetése napján büszkélkedtek el egy férfi megmentéséről
latvia.description: Átvizsgálták a korábbi működésüket, és észlelték, hogy ezt a hibát korábban többször elkövethették.

latvia.title: Bocsánatot kért az OMSZ főigazgatója, miután egy férfi temetésének napján posztoltak a megmentéséről
latvia.description: Felülvizsgálják a kommunikációs gyakorlatot.

latvia.title: Betörtek az oroszok a NATO légterébe, katasztrófa szélén Oleski - Híreink az orosz-ukrán háborúról csütörtökön
latvia.description: Meghívták Vlagyimir Putyin orosz elnököt a decemberi G20 csúcsra, az Egyesült Államokba, a Kreml azt nyilatkozta, hogy fontolóra veszik a dolgot. Az orosz megszállás alatt álló Oleski városának humanitárius ellátása teljesen összeomlott, az ukránok szerint az oroszok mesterségesen éheztetik ki a települést. A donyecki fronton az oroszok Dobropillját, Kosztyantynivkát és Limant szorongatják, a harkivi fronton több település orosz megszállás alá került a napokban. Az orosz erők többször is megsértették a NATO légterét: tegnap egy Mi-8-as, ma egy drón hatolt be a szövetség országaiba engedély nélkül. Cikkünk folyamatosan frissül.

latvia.title: Elárulta a NATO erős embere, milyen választ adnak a növekvő orosz fenyegetésre
latvia.description: A NATO fokozza a hírszerzési adatok megosztását az orosz hibrid fenyegetésekre válaszul - nyilatkozta a Reutersnek Alexus Grynkewich, a szövetség európai erőinek legfõbb parancsnoka a The Guardian beszámolója szerint.

latvia.title: Tusk o swojej kandydatce: co ja zrobiłem?
latvia.description: Premier Donald Tusk pojawił się w Krakowie na otwartym spotkaniu z senator Moniką Piątkowską, kandydatką KO i PSL na prezydenta Krakowa. Poinformował, że polityczka miałaby stworzyć "duet" z ministrem finansów Andrzejem Domańskim, który ma narzędzia do "umiejętnego wykorzystania wszystkich narzędzi" do wsparcia Krakowa. Piątkowska zadeklarowała, że nie będzie zgadzać się z rządem Tuska we wszystkim. - Co ja zrobiłem? - odparł lider KO.

latvia.title: Američania nechávajú časť obrany na pleciach Európy. A čo článok 5?
latvia.description: Spojené štáty budú naďalej poskytovať kľúčové, ale zároveň obmedzenejšie kapacity Severoatlantickej aliancie (NATO), zatiaľ čo Európania preberajú väčšiu úlohu v obrane kontinentu. Agentúre Reuters to dnes povedal vrchný veliteľ aliančných síl v Európe Alexus Gtrhewich. NATO podľa neho posilňuje zdieľanie informácií a spravodajstva v reakcii na hybridné útoky.

latvia.title: Ruské hybridní útoky budou častější a s většími následky, varují Dánové
latvia.description: Ruská hybridní válka proti západním zemím v nadcházejících měsících pravděpodobně nabere na intenzitě, varovala ve čtvrtek dánská vojenská zpravodajská služba. Přímý útok na některého ze členů NATO považuje za nepravděpodobný, ale ne vyloučený.

latvia.title: Naši lidé. Nvotová natočila minisérii o vraždě Kuciaka a Kušnírové
latvia.description: Osm let po vraždě novináře Jána Kuciaka a jeho snoubenky Martiny Kušnírové vznikla hraná minisérie, která tyto události zpracovává v širších souvislostech. Šestidílný seriál Naši lidé pro Českou televizi natočila slovenská režisérka Tereza Nvotová. Zároveň se s Mirem Šifrou a Tomášem Hrubým podílela na scénáři. Názvem Naši lidé tvůrci odkazují ke slovnímu spojení, které na Slovensku označuje síť blízkých osob spojených klientelismem, korupcí a napojením na politickou reprezentaci.

latvia.title: Războiul din Ucraina schimbă planurile lui Marine Le Pen pentru rolul Franței în NATO: „Nu este momentul”
latvia.description: Marine Le Pen intenționează în continuare să retragă Franța din structura de comandă militară integrată a NATO, însă spune că nu va face acest pas atât timp cât războiul Rusiei în Ucraina continuă. Lidera Rassemblement National, favorită în sondajele pentru alegerile prezidențiale de anul viitor, a declarat pentru POLITICO că, „atât timp cât există un război la porțile Europei”, nu este momentul pentru o astfel de decizie.

latvia.title: Mark Rutte dă asigurări că NATO este pregătită să facă faţă atacurilor hibride ale Moscovei. „Rusia îşi intensifică acţiunile”
latvia.description: NATO este „pregătită” să facă faţă atacurilor cibernetice ruseşti şi altor forme de război hibrid, a declarat joi secretarul general al Alianţei Nord-Atlantice, Mark Rutte. El a cerut un sprijin sporit pentru Ucraina ca răspuns la acţiunile Moscovei.

latvia.title: Raport: Rusia ar putea ataca o țară NATO în următoarele luni, avertizează serviciile secrete daneze
latvia.description: Rusia ar putea desfășura în lunile următoare o operațiune militară limitată împotriva uneia dintre țările NATO, a declarat Serviciul de Informații și Securitate Militară (DDIS) al Danemarcei.

latvia.title: „Reacționează doar la forță”. Avertismentul dur al premierului Republicii Moldova, Vasile Tofan, privind acțiunile lui Putin
latvia.description: Premierul Republicii Moldova, Vasile Tofan, a dezvăluit, într-un interviu pentru CNN, care este „secretul” care a făcut ca ţara sa să reziste intenselor încercări de destabilizare din partea Rusiei, avertizând totodată că Europa trebuie să fie pregătită să se confrunte cu şi mai multă propagandă din partea Moscovei, care face posibilă victoria unor partide extremiste în ţări cu democraţii consolidate. În legătură cu survolul dronelor, el a spus că nu consideră că există o ameninţare iminentă pentru Moldova în ceea ce priveşte o potenţială incursiune, fiind de părere că Rusia mai degrabă testează ţările NATO. Rusia nu reacţionează la slăbiciune, ci reacţionează doar la forţă, a avertizat şeful guvernului de la Chişinău.

latvia.title: Ce spune Predoiu despre propunerea unei Poliții unice: „Urez succes în discuţiile cu organizaţiile asociative ale primarilor din ţară”
latvia.description: Ministrul interimar de Interne, senatorul Cătălin Predoiu, declară joi că, dacă ajunge în Parlament, va vota Guvernul Siegfried Mureşan, el arătând că este nevoie urgentă de un guvern pro-occidental cu puteri depline.

latvia.title: Olanda anunţă prelungirea operațiunilor de Poliție Aeriană. Dronele MQ-9 Reaper vor rămâne în România până la 31 decembrie 2027
latvia.description: Olanda prelungeşte din nou desfăşurarea dronelor sale MQ-9 Reaper care operează din Câmpia Turzii, în România, anunţă, joi, Ambasada Olandei în România. Avioanele fără pilot vor contribui acum la apărarea Flancului Estic al NATO până la 31 decembrie 2027.

latvia.title: „Rusia a pierdut deja războiul din Ucraina”, susține președintele unei țări NATO și UE
latvia.description: Rusia „a pierdut deja” războiul împotriva Ucrainei, a afirmat președintele lituanian Gitanas Nausėda, invocând costurile militare „enorme” suportate de Moscova.

latvia.title: Avioane de vânătoare poloneze, ridicate pentru a intercepta un aparat de spionaj rus Il-20, în largul coastei Mării Baltice
latvia.description: Avioanele de vânătoare poloneze au interceptat marți un avion de spionaj rus în largul coastei poloneze a Mării Baltice, a declarat ministrul Apărării, Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz.

latvia.title: Ce prevede acordul istoric privind Groenlanda: noi baze militare, reguli pentru investiții și promisiuni pentru NATO
latvia.description: Statele Unite, Danemarca și Groenlanda au semnat, marți, un acord de securitate menit să pună capăt lunilor de tensiuni privind teritoriul danez autonom, după amenințările repetate ale președintelui american Donald Trump de a prelua controlul asupra vastei insule arctice. Reuters a prezentat câteva componente cheie ale acordului, care se adaugă unui pact americano-danez din 1951 privind apărarea Groenlandei, conform unui text publicat de Guvernul danez.

latvia.title: Nicușor Dan, la CNN: Nu e foarte probabil ca Rusia să atace o țară NATO în următorii unu-doi ani, dar trebuie să fim pregătiți
latvia.description: Preşedintele Nicuşor Dan, aflat la New York pentru cea de-a 81-a sesiune a Adunării Generale a Organizaţiei Naţiunilor Unite, a declarat că „nu este foarte probabil” ca Rusia să atace o ţară NATO „în următorii unu-doi ani”, dar România trebuie să fie pregătită. De asemenea, şeful statului nu crede că Rusia este cu adevărat pregătită să pună capăt războiului şi apreciază că preşedintele Donald Trump „are dreptate” că Europa trebuie să se implice mai mult în propria apărare.

latvia.title: NATO învață în țările baltice cum să poarte un război în epoca dronelor: De ce „un tanc pe câmpul de luptă este acum ca un tort”
latvia.description: În țările baltice, forțele NATO încearcă zilele acestea să învețe noul mod de a face război, folosindu-se de lecțiile de pe frontul ucrainean, iar militarii văd cum doctrina militară tradițională a devenit învechită și neadecvată.

latvia.title: Marine Le Pen introduce o nuanță în poziția sa anti-NATO. „Dar, desigur, dorința mea de a face acest lucru rămâne”
latvia.description: Marine Le Pen, candidată la alegerile prezidențiale de anul viitor, a declarat pentru Politico că își dorește în continuare ieșirea Franței din structura de comandă integrată a NATO, dar că acest lucru nu trebuie să se întâmple cât încă este în desfășurare războiul din Ucraina. „Atât timp cât există un război la porțile Europei, acesta …

latvia.title: Gestul pe care spune Peiu că îl așteaptă AUR de la PSD pentru a negocia o majoritate, „după căderea previzibilă a guvernului Mureșan”
latvia.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrișor Peiu, a reiterat că parlamentarii partidului său nu vor susține învestirea guvernului Mureșan și „cel mai probabil” vor părăsi sala la eventualul vot din Parlament. Peiu a declarat, joi seară, la Antena 3, că AUR nu exclude posibilitatea de a negocia cu PSD „după căderea previzibilă a guvernului Mureșan”, cu condiția …

latvia.title: Generalul care conduce NATO spune deschis că, în prezent, „suntem cu toții țări de pe flancul estic” și îl avertizează pe Putin: „Să nu încerce cât sunt eu la comandă”
latvia.description: Țările NATO intensifică schimbul din domeniul intelligence-ului ca răspuns la valul de sabotaje și alte incidente aparent legate de Rusia, dar alianța ar trebui să fie „calmă și încrezătoare” că poate face față oricărei amenințări reprezentate de Moscova, a spus joi comandantul de top al organizației militare internaționale. Declarațiile generalului Alexus Grynkewich, din cadrul Forțelor …

latvia.title: Tarmo Miilits: Russia shows no intent to attack a NATO country right now
latvia.description: Let's turn the fear temperature down, because we have no signs indicating that Russia currently intends to militarily attack any NATO ally, writes Tarmo Miilits.

latvia.title: Saaremaa residents oppose Elering's planned Estonia–Latvia overhead power line
latvia.description: Many Saaremaa residents — as well as the Saaremaa municipal government — do not support Elering's plan to build a 330 kV Estonia–Latvia overhead power line across Saaremaa. Locals prefer an underground cable or a subsea cable running directly to Latvia.

latvia.title: Illegal immigration to Estonia rises, border rotation extended
latvia.description: Interior Minister Igor Taro (Eesti 200) says illegal immigration into Estonia has grown. Estonia is extending its border‑guard rotation on the Latvia–Belarus border.

latvia.title: Politician Stepaņenko's father blacklisted in Latvia
latvia.description: Sergey Fedotov, the father of politician Jūlija Stepaņenko (Sovereign Power/Union of New Latvians), a candidate in the 15th Saeima elections, has recently come to public attention. On Thursday, Foreign Minister Baiba Braže (New Unity) added Fedotov to Latvia’s list of undesirable persons, barring him from entering the country for an indefinite period.

latvia.title: Border controls on grain shipments to be introduced in Latvia
latvia.description: To ensure that cargoes stolen in Ukraine, including grain, are not transported through Latvian territory, the Saeima adopted an amendment to the Animal Feed Circulation Law in its final reading on Thursday, 24 September, according to the Saeima’s press office.

latvia.title: Latvia will send up to 20 soldiers to clear Hormuz
latvia.description: On Thursday, 24 September, the Saeima approved the participation of the National Armed Forces (NBS) in multinational military operations to secure the Strait of Hormuz. Latvia plans to deploy up to 20 soldiers to clear the Strait of Hormuz of mines.

latvia.title: Man murders relative in Rīga, drops body on street
latvia.description: In mid-September, a woman showing signs of a violent death was found in Rīga, in the Jugla neighbourhood, near a block of flats, the State Police reported on September 24.

latvia.title: Charity concert for Ukraine to take place Sunday in Rīga
latvia.description: On 27 September at 5.00 pm, ‘Brūzis Manufaktūra’, Brīvības gatve 401, Rīga, will host the ‘Ganta Foundation’ charity concert and storytelling evening, ‘Stories That Must Be Heard’, the organisers announced.

latvia.title: Excise tax on fuel to be reduced in Latvia
latvia.description: On Thursday, 24 September, the Saeima approved, at its final reading, amendments to the Law on Limiting Price Increases for Petroleum Products, which provide for a reduction in the excise duty rate on diesel fuel and unleaded petrol from 1 October until the end of the year.

latvia.title: Saeima conceptually agrees to being audited
latvia.description: On Thursday, 24 September, the Saeima supported, at first reading, amendments granting the State Audit Office the right to carry out a financial audit of the accuracy of the annual report prepared by the Saeima.

latvia.title: Salaspils unveils new concert hall
latvia.description: Whilst Rīga is still waiting for a new concert hall, a multifunctional and modern concert hall has opened its doors nearby – in Salaspils, Latvian Television reported on September 23.

latvia.title: Latvia will host 2030 BMX world championship
latvia.description: Latvia has secured the right to host the BMX World Championships in Valmiera in 2030, and this will be the first time such a high-level competition has been held in a Baltic state, Toms Markss, Secretary General of the Latvian Cycling Federation (LRF), told Latvian Television.

latvia.title: Politician Stepaņenko's family reportedly friendly with Russian arms dealer Bout
latvia.description: ‘Sovereign Power/Union of New Latvians’ is among the frontrunners in the polls ahead of the Saeima elections expected in early October. Its Prime Minister candidate Jūlija Stepaņenko has in recent weeks avoided answering questions about her father, who lives in Russia and from whom she has received substantial gifts, Latvian Television reported on September 23.

latvia.title: Rail Baltica's deadline officially extended by all Baltic States
latvia.description: The much-touted target date of 2030, by which the first phase of the “Rail Baltica” railway project – worth more than 14 billion euros – was due to be completed, is no longer a realistic prospect, as finally officially acknowledged by the leaders of the Baltic states, Latvian Radio reported on September 23.

latvia.title: Police chase 13-year-old reckless driver in Latvia
latvia.description: The State Police has reported an unusal chase where the driver was 13 years old.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 23rd December, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Attempts to reduce fuel prices being put forward in Latvia
latvia.description: Several draft laws aimed at reducing fuel prices are being put forward for approval by the Saeima. This was decided on Wednesday by the Saeima’s Budget and Finance (Tax) Committee, according to the Saeima Press Service.

latvia.title: Don't dump your apples in the nearest (or farthest) forest
latvia.description: With harvest in full swing, the question of where to put left-over apples, grass and other organic waste becomes more pressing for many home and garden owners.

latvia.title: Infection affects dozens of children in Salaspils kindergarten, Latvia
latvia.description: At the “Jāņtārpiņš” kindergarten in Salaspils, dozens of children have been found to be suffering from an illness of unknown origin. Similar symptoms have also been observed in several adults – members of the nursery staff. The Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (SPKC) has already launched an epidemiological investigation, and the Food and Veterinary Service (PVD) will carry out inspections on Wednesday, Latvian Radio reports.

latvia.title: Reminder issued to vaccinate dogs against canine distemper virus
latvia.description: Foxes in Ādaži Municipality have recently been laboratory-confirmed as infected with canine distemper (CDV); therefore, the Food and Veterinary Service (PVD) urges dog owners to ensure that their dog has been vaccinated against this highly contagious viral disease.

latvia.title: Latvians will get European-standard cards for disabled parking
latvia.description: To ensure that people with disabilities have uniform rights to use parking concessions throughout the European Union, the Latvian Ministry of Transport has drawn up amendments to the Road Traffic Regulations, which provide for a gradual transition from the current disabled parking card to the new European parking card.

latvia.title: Hacker detained in Latvia for at least two cyberattacks
latvia.description: On 15 September this year, the State Police arrested a hacker born in 2003 on suspicion of carrying out cyber-attacks against at least two Latvian companies for financial gain, the police said on September 23.

latvia.title: Latvia approves vague plan for curbing immigration
latvia.description: On Tuesday, 22 September, the Government endorsed the plan for measures to restrict immigration drawn up by the Ministry of the Interior (MoI), which includes more than 70 recommendations for controlling and restricting immigration.

latvia.title: Latvian government imposes restrictions on two Russian oligarchs
latvia.description: On Tuesday, the Latvian government imposed nationwide financial and entry restrictions on the Russian oligarchs Mikhail Fridman and Alisher Usmanov, according to documents attached to the agenda of the Cabinet of Ministers’ meeting.

latvia.title: Concerns about traffic flow during repairs of major Rīga bridge
latvia.description: What will the traffic situation be like in Rīga when the dilapidated Vanšu Bridge is repaired? With about a year to go before work begins, this remains unknown. Businesses and the Mārupe Municipal Council are concerned about this, Latvian Radio and Latvian Television reported on September 23.

latvia.title: Road safety week saw more accidents but fewer casualties this year in Latvia
latvia.description: The “Roadpol Safety Days” campaign, organised by the European traffic police network “Roadpol”, has come to an end. During the campaign, police forces across Europe, including in Latvia, focused more actively on road safety than they do on a day-to-day basis, Juris Jančevskis, Head of the Response Directorate at the State Police, said in an interview with Latvian Television on Wednesday morning.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 22nd September, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Rīga Music Week returns in November
latvia.description: The organisers of Riga Music Week have announced the first 28 artists for the city festival, hailing from eight countries. The festival will take place on 4 and 5 November across seven stages in the Tallinas Street quarter, according to the organisers.

latvia.title: Two out of three jewellery burglars caught in Jelgava, Latvia
latvia.description: Following a chase on Thursday, 17 September, the State Police arrested two people in Jelgava who had burgled a jewellery shop in Bauska a week earlier, the State Police have reported.

latvia.title: Latvian company gets European design award
latvia.description: The Latvian company ‘Carbon Less Future’ has won an award from the European Union Intellectual Property Office (EUIPO) in the ‘Entrepreneurs and Small Businesses’ category of the ‘DesignEuropa Awards’, LSM.lv reports on September 22.

latvia.title: 'Ulya' a slam dunk amongst Latvian public
latvia.description: Last weekend, Viesturs Kairišs’ feature film Uļa/Ulya became the most-watched film in Latvia on the opening weekend.

latvia.title: Man arrested in Rīga on suspicion of sexual harassment
latvia.description: On 18 September, officers from the Riga Regional Directorate of the State Police detained a man born in 1998 at a shopping centre in Riga, who had allegedly approached underage girls and offered them money in exchange for engaging in sexual acts. The suspect has been remanded in custody.

latvia.title: Ombudsman reports malnutrition at orphanage in Latgale
latvia.description: Ombudsman Karina Palkova has identified significant violations of children’s rights at a children’s home in Latgale, including inadequate nutrition and funding for the children’s needs, as well as staff failing to communicate sufficiently in the state language, Palkova said in an interview on the Latvian Radio programme “Good Morning” on September 22.

latvia.title: Drug bust in Rīga and Ādaži last week
latvia.description: Last week, the police arrested an organised group of six people in Rīga and the surrounding area on suspicion of drug dealing. Several storage facilities were uncovered, and a large quantity of various narcotic substances was seized: cannabis, cocaine, amphetamine and other substances, police said on September 21.

latvia.title: Rīga will seek to slow heating price rise
latvia.description: The Minister for Economic Affairs, Viktors Valainis (Union of Greens and Farmers), has instructed ‘Rīgas siltums’ and the Ministry of Economic Affairs (EM) to draw up proposals this week on how to reduce the expected rise in heating tariffs in Riga. The company currently estimates that the tariff could rise by 20 to 30 per cent from December.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 21st September, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Possible air threat warning in Krāslava municipality of Latvia is over
latvia.description: The National Armed Forces have issued a warning covering Krāslava municipality regarding a potential threat to airspace. A cell broadcast alert was sent to residents of this municipality. The warning that had been issued ended shortly before midnight.

latvia.title: Most household energy consumption goes to heating in Latvia
latvia.description: According to the Central Statistical Bureau survey on energy consumption in households, published on September 21, 83.9 % of the energy resources consumed in households in 2025 were used for space and water heating.

latvia.title: National Alliance kicks out violence apologist Dalbiņš
latvia.description: The Executive Committee of the National Alliance (NA) has decided to expel Valts Dalbiņš, a candidate for a seat in the 15th Saeima, from the party, as he has, in posts on social media, justified violence against women and levelled prejudiced accusations against them.

latvia.title: Temporary bridge to be installed during Vanšu Bridge repairs in Rīga
latvia.description: A temporary bridge is to be erected whilst the Vanšu Bridge is being rebuilt, the Mayor of Riga, Viesturs Kleinbergs (Progressives), has stated on September 21.

latvia.title: Less than 1% turnout in Latvia for Russia's so-called elections
latvia.description: According to the State Police, 290 Russian citizens in Rīga took part in the Russian "elections", representing just 0.8 per cent of all Russian citizens eligible to vote in Latvia.

latvia.title: Latvian bank profits down 2.9% in first half of 2026
latvia.description: The Latvian banking sector posted a profit of 205.301 million euros in the first half of this year, which is 2.9 per cent less than in the corresponding period of 2025, according to data published by the Latvian Central Bank (Bank of Latvia) on September 21.

latvia.title: Hint of summer might still come next week in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts indicate that rain is expected frequently in Latvia this week.

latvia.title: More details emerge in big illegal cigarette case in Latvia
latvia.description: Almost two years ago, the police uncovered an illegal cigarette distribution network; some of those involved are now in the dock, whilst others are still awaiting trial. The initial investigation has given rise to several parallel cases, Latvian Television's De Facto reported on September 21.

latvia.title: Buzzing honey yields this year in Latvia
latvia.description: For the fourteenth year running, the Latvian Beekeepers’ Association (LBB) has been organising the ‘Honey Day at the Apiary’ event, with the aim of promoting honey and other bee products to the public. Throughout the month, around 30 apiaries across all regions opened their doors to the public, TV Kurzeme reported on September 20.

latvia.title: 'Catch some flavour' in Kuldīga, Latvia this week
latvia.description: In Kuldīga, the gastronomic event “Catch the Flavour!” is extending into the autumn with beloved seasonal dishes made mainly of spuds. Overall, it has been a busy summer for restaurateurs, and there is still a steady flow of visitors in September, Latvian Radio reported on September 21.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 20th September, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Rain and thunder across Latvia on Monday
latvia.description: Forecasts indicate that rain is expected across Latvia on Monday.

latvia.title: WATCH AGAIN: Latvia versus Poland international volleyball
latvia.description: A crucial win over Turkiye on September 16th means Latvia has made it into the knock-out stages of the men's European volleyball championships.

latvia.title: LISTEN: Pēteris Vasks sacred music concert
latvia.description: The closing concert of the 29th International Sacred Music Festival featured a special concert of music by this year’s jubilee composer Pēteris Vasks, who is 80 years old.

latvia.title: Latvian border guards stop more illegal crossers
latvia.description: On Thursday, September 17, in Krāslava Municipality, border guards, in cooperation with State Police officers, detained a person transporting individuals who had illegally crossed the state border.

latvia.title: Kulbergs and Braže meet U.S. envoy to Belarus
latvia.description: On Thursday, 17th September 2026, the Latvian Minister of Foreign Affairs, Baiba Braže, met with the US Special Envoy to Belarus, John Coale.

latvia.title: KNAB to investigate ZZS handing out booze
latvia.description: The Corruption Prevention and Combating Bureau (KNAB) will investigate an incident in which the Union of Greens and Farmers (ZZS) gave bottles of black balsam to senior citizens, KNAB said on September 18. This week, on the Latvian Radio programme “Krustpunktā”, a listener asked ZZS MP Augusts Brigmanis to comment on the fact that, at a seniors’ gathering in Ogre on 23 August, the ZZS had given small souvenirs to senior citizens, including a “small bottle of black balsam” bearing the ZZS’s list number for the forthcoming Saeima elections.

latvia.title: VIDEO. Oponents nolikts pie vietas: lapsu “politiskās cīņas” uz dārza galda smīdina soctīklus
latvia.description: Kā jau iepriekš vēstījām, ģimenes uzņēmuma “Mārlapiņi” dārzā regulāri ciemos iegriežas bezbailīgas un ziņkārīgas lapsas, kuru jautrās aktivitātes un kāpelēšana pa dārza mēbelēm jau iekarojusi daudzu sirdis. Nesen publicēts kārtējais videoieraksts, kurā rudastes sarīkojušas “politisko cīņu” paraugdemonstrējumu. Video redzams, kā divas lapsas uz koka dārza galda atkal ļāvušās spēlēm un rotaļīgai spēka mērīšanai, vienai otru […]

latvia.title: Rēzeknē meklē 15 gadus veco Ruslanu Krupnovu
latvia.description: Valsts policijas Latgales reģiona pārvaldes Ziemeļlatgales iecirkņa amatpersonas meklē bezvēsts prombūtnē esošo 2011. gadā dzimušo Ruslanu Krupnovu, kurš 2026.gada 12.septembrī aizgāja no savas dzīvesvietas Rēzeknē un nav atgriezies, kā arī nav devis ziņu par šī brīža atrašanās vietu. Bija ģērbies pelēkas krāsas džemperī, pelēkas krāsas sporta biksēs ar baltām svītrām sānos un tumšas krāsas sporta […]

latvia.title: “Viens no Krievijas mērķiem ir…” Dūrītis atzīst, ka Latvijai jābūt gatavai dažādām provokācijām
latvia.description: Diskusijas par iespējamiem Krievijas draudiem NATO valstīm turpinās, taču vienlaikus iedzīvotājiem jāspēj atšķirt reālus drošības riskus no informācijas, kas var radīt nevajadzīgu paniku. TV24 raidījumā “Preses klubs” Ilmārs Dūrītis, Latvijas Biozinātņu un tehnoloģiju universitātes profesors, Latvijas Veterinārārstu biedrības valdes priekšsēdētājs, “Kustība Par!” biedrs uzsvēra, ka Latvijai ir jābūt gatavai dažādiem scenārijiem, vienlaikus saglabājot vēsu prātu. […]

latvia.title: Lietuva un Polija apspriedīs iedzīvotāju evakuāciju Krievijas uzbrukuma gadījumā. Kas notiek Latvijā?
latvia.description: Lietuvas premjerministrs Mindaugs Sinkevičs paziņojis, ka Lietuva ar Poliju plāno apspriest iespējamu sadarbību iedzīvotāju evakuācijā gadījumā, ja valsts saskartos ar Krievijas militāru uzbrukumu vai citu nopietnu apdraudējumu. Sarunas paredzētas oktobrī Varšavā. Kā vēsta Lietuvas sabiedriskais medijs LRT, Sinkevičs jautājumu par sadarbību evakuācijas jomā plāno apspriest ar Polijas amatpersonām divpusējās tikšanās reizēs. Viņš norādījis, ka tiešas […]

latvia.title: Lēnām, bet pārliecinoši: maz zināms seksa paņēmiens, kas sniedz neiedomājamu baudu
latvia.description: Bieži saka, ka sacensībās uzvar tie, kuri skrien lēnām un vienmērīgi. Gultā šis maz zināmais seksa paņēmiens noteikti var palīdzēt sasniegt finiša līniju. Iespējams, neesat dzirdējuši par lēno izvilkšanu (angļu val. outstroking), taču ir ļoti ticami, ka esat to praktizējuši paši to pat neapzinoties. Īsumā tas nozīmē lēnu dzimumlocekļa vai seksa rotaļlietas izvilkšanu no maksts […]

latvia.title: Sezonāla problēma – atkal izplatās parazīts, kas ēd cilvēka ādas šūnas
latvia.description: Vasaras tveice pamazām atkāpjas, taču pastaigas dabā rudenī nebūt nekļūst pilnīgi bezrūpīgas. Tieši septembrī un oktobrī īpaši aktīvas kļūst tā dēvētās ražas ērcītes – mikroskopiski parazīti, kas var pieķerties gan cilvēkiem, gan dzīvniekiem. Tās ir tik mazas, ka ar neapbruņotu aci kukaini pamanīt ir ārkārtīgi grūti. Taču pēc kontakta ar šiem parazītiem uz ādas var […]

latvia.title: “Novērtējiet to, ko mežā var dabūt par velti!” Latviete parāda, cik Itālijā maksā gailenes
latvia.description: Latvietim gailene ir viena no tām vasaras un rudens veltēm, kuru pierasts meklēt mežā pašam. Grozs rokā, dažas stundas svaigā gaisā, un veiksmīgā dienā vakariņām pietiek ne tikai pašam, bet vēl paliek ko paslēpt saldētavā nebaltai dienai. Tāpēc, ieraugot tās pašas sēnes glīti safasētas lielveikala plauktā par gandrīz 20 eiro kilogramā, cenu atšķirība var šķist […]

latvia.title: Atbild Slaidiņš: Kāpēc krievi var atļauties sūtīt ziemeļkorejiešus, bet tā nav eskalācija?
latvia.description: Krievija turpina izmantot Ziemeļkorejas atbalstu karā pret Ukrainu, un šāda militārā sadarbība Maskavai ļauj atslogot savus spēkus citos frontes un pierobežas sektoros, tā TV24 raidījumā “Aktuālais par karadarbību Ukrainā” sacīja NBS majors, Zemessardzes štāba virsnieks Jānis Slaidiņš. Raidījuma sākumā izskanēja skatītāja jautājums par to, kāpēc Krievijas sadarbība ar Ziemeļkoreju un tās karavīru nosūtīšana uz Krievijas […]

latvia.title: VIDEO. Izgāzās kā veca sēta! Princis Harijs spiests steigā pamest skatuvi, runājot par mākslīgo intelektu
latvia.description: Princis Harijs piedzīvojis neveiklu brīdi Klintona globālās iniciatīvas ikgadējā sanāksmē Ņujorkā. Saseksas hercogs bija ieradies, lai brīdinātu par mākslīgā intelekta un sociālo tīklu iespējamo ietekmi uz bērniem, taču aptuveni septiņas minūtes pēc runas sākuma pārstāja darboties teleprompters, un Harijs savu uzstāšanos vairs nevarēja turpināt. Incidents notika trešdien, 23. septembrī. “Reuters” fotogrāfijas apstiprina, ka Harijs tajā […]

lithuania.title: France would defend eastern flank borders even outside NATO, says Mélenchon
lithuania.description: The far-left presidential candidate also criticized Germany's rearmament in an interview with POLITICO.

lithuania.title: Erdoğan tells UN that Europe cannot be safe without Turkey
lithuania.description: Speaking at the UN General Assembly, Erdoğan argued that Turkey is an indispensable part of European security architecture. Turkey has been a NATO member since 1952 but its EU accession process has been frozen for nearly a decade.

lithuania.title: Videóban kért bocsánatot az Országos Mentőszolgálat főigazgatója a félresikerült posztjuk után
lithuania.description: Constantinovits Miklós szerint ez nem az az irány, amerre szeretnék, hogy a mentőszolgálat haladjon.

lithuania.title: Brovdi: Putyin 300 ezer embert tervez mozgósítani és a frontra küldeni még az év vége előtt
lithuania.description: A magyar származású ukrán drónparancsnok szerint mindig lesz egy Orbán, aki akadályozza a NATO működését.

lithuania.title: Dán hírszerzés: Oroszország fokozni fogja a hibrid háborúját, egy NATO-tagállam elleni katonai támadás sem kizárt
lithuania.description: Moszkva célja a NATO megosztása – állapította meg a dán hírszerzés jelentése.

lithuania.title: A dán hírszerzés szerint Oroszország korlátozott támadást intézhet egy NATO-ország ellen hónapokon belül
lithuania.description: A dán szolgálatok szerint Oroszország megpróbálhatja tesztelni a NATO 5. cikkelyét, ami a tagállamok kollektív védelmét írja elő.

lithuania.title: Videóban kért bocsánatot az Országos Mentőszolgálat főigazgatója, miután a temetése napján büszkélkedtek el egy férfi megmentéséről
lithuania.description: Átvizsgálták a korábbi működésüket, és észlelték, hogy ezt a hibát korábban többször elkövethették.

lithuania.title: Bocsánatot kért az OMSZ főigazgatója, miután egy férfi temetésének napján posztoltak a megmentéséről
lithuania.description: Felülvizsgálják a kommunikációs gyakorlatot.

lithuania.title: Betörtek az oroszok a NATO légterébe, katasztrófa szélén Oleski - Híreink az orosz-ukrán háborúról csütörtökön
lithuania.description: Meghívták Vlagyimir Putyin orosz elnököt a decemberi G20 csúcsra, az Egyesült Államokba, a Kreml azt nyilatkozta, hogy fontolóra veszik a dolgot. Az orosz megszállás alatt álló Oleski városának humanitárius ellátása teljesen összeomlott, az ukránok szerint az oroszok mesterségesen éheztetik ki a települést. A donyecki fronton az oroszok Dobropillját, Kosztyantynivkát és Limant szorongatják, a harkivi fronton több település orosz megszállás alá került a napokban. Az orosz erők többször is megsértették a NATO légterét: tegnap egy Mi-8-as, ma egy drón hatolt be a szövetség országaiba engedély nélkül. Cikkünk folyamatosan frissül.

lithuania.title: Elárulta a NATO erős embere, milyen választ adnak a növekvő orosz fenyegetésre
lithuania.description: A NATO fokozza a hírszerzési adatok megosztását az orosz hibrid fenyegetésekre válaszul - nyilatkozta a Reutersnek Alexus Grynkewich, a szövetség európai erőinek legfõbb parancsnoka a The Guardian beszámolója szerint.

lithuania.title: Tusk o swojej kandydatce: co ja zrobiłem?
lithuania.description: Premier Donald Tusk pojawił się w Krakowie na otwartym spotkaniu z senator Moniką Piątkowską, kandydatką KO i PSL na prezydenta Krakowa. Poinformował, że polityczka miałaby stworzyć "duet" z ministrem finansów Andrzejem Domańskim, który ma narzędzia do "umiejętnego wykorzystania wszystkich narzędzi" do wsparcia Krakowa. Piątkowska zadeklarowała, że nie będzie zgadzać się z rządem Tuska we wszystkim. - Co ja zrobiłem? - odparł lider KO.

lithuania.title: Američania nechávajú časť obrany na pleciach Európy. A čo článok 5?
lithuania.description: Spojené štáty budú naďalej poskytovať kľúčové, ale zároveň obmedzenejšie kapacity Severoatlantickej aliancie (NATO), zatiaľ čo Európania preberajú väčšiu úlohu v obrane kontinentu. Agentúre Reuters to dnes povedal vrchný veliteľ aliančných síl v Európe Alexus Gtrhewich. NATO podľa neho posilňuje zdieľanie informácií a spravodajstva v reakcii na hybridné útoky.

lithuania.title: Ruské hybridní útoky budou častější a s většími následky, varují Dánové
lithuania.description: Ruská hybridní válka proti západním zemím v nadcházejících měsících pravděpodobně nabere na intenzitě, varovala ve čtvrtek dánská vojenská zpravodajská služba. Přímý útok na některého ze členů NATO považuje za nepravděpodobný, ale ne vyloučený.

lithuania.title: Naši lidé. Nvotová natočila minisérii o vraždě Kuciaka a Kušnírové
lithuania.description: Osm let po vraždě novináře Jána Kuciaka a jeho snoubenky Martiny Kušnírové vznikla hraná minisérie, která tyto události zpracovává v širších souvislostech. Šestidílný seriál Naši lidé pro Českou televizi natočila slovenská režisérka Tereza Nvotová. Zároveň se s Mirem Šifrou a Tomášem Hrubým podílela na scénáři. Názvem Naši lidé tvůrci odkazují ke slovnímu spojení, které na Slovensku označuje síť blízkých osob spojených klientelismem, korupcí a napojením na politickou reprezentaci.

lithuania.title: Războiul din Ucraina schimbă planurile lui Marine Le Pen pentru rolul Franței în NATO: „Nu este momentul”
lithuania.description: Marine Le Pen intenționează în continuare să retragă Franța din structura de comandă militară integrată a NATO, însă spune că nu va face acest pas atât timp cât războiul Rusiei în Ucraina continuă. Lidera Rassemblement National, favorită în sondajele pentru alegerile prezidențiale de anul viitor, a declarat pentru POLITICO că, „atât timp cât există un război la porțile Europei”, nu este momentul pentru o astfel de decizie.

lithuania.title: Mark Rutte dă asigurări că NATO este pregătită să facă faţă atacurilor hibride ale Moscovei. „Rusia îşi intensifică acţiunile”
lithuania.description: NATO este „pregătită” să facă faţă atacurilor cibernetice ruseşti şi altor forme de război hibrid, a declarat joi secretarul general al Alianţei Nord-Atlantice, Mark Rutte. El a cerut un sprijin sporit pentru Ucraina ca răspuns la acţiunile Moscovei.

lithuania.title: Raport: Rusia ar putea ataca o țară NATO în următoarele luni, avertizează serviciile secrete daneze
lithuania.description: Rusia ar putea desfășura în lunile următoare o operațiune militară limitată împotriva uneia dintre țările NATO, a declarat Serviciul de Informații și Securitate Militară (DDIS) al Danemarcei.

lithuania.title: „Reacționează doar la forță”. Avertismentul dur al premierului Republicii Moldova, Vasile Tofan, privind acțiunile lui Putin
lithuania.description: Premierul Republicii Moldova, Vasile Tofan, a dezvăluit, într-un interviu pentru CNN, care este „secretul” care a făcut ca ţara sa să reziste intenselor încercări de destabilizare din partea Rusiei, avertizând totodată că Europa trebuie să fie pregătită să se confrunte cu şi mai multă propagandă din partea Moscovei, care face posibilă victoria unor partide extremiste în ţări cu democraţii consolidate. În legătură cu survolul dronelor, el a spus că nu consideră că există o ameninţare iminentă pentru Moldova în ceea ce priveşte o potenţială incursiune, fiind de părere că Rusia mai degrabă testează ţările NATO. Rusia nu reacţionează la slăbiciune, ci reacţionează doar la forţă, a avertizat şeful guvernului de la Chişinău.

lithuania.title: Ce spune Predoiu despre propunerea unei Poliții unice: „Urez succes în discuţiile cu organizaţiile asociative ale primarilor din ţară”
lithuania.description: Ministrul interimar de Interne, senatorul Cătălin Predoiu, declară joi că, dacă ajunge în Parlament, va vota Guvernul Siegfried Mureşan, el arătând că este nevoie urgentă de un guvern pro-occidental cu puteri depline.

lithuania.title: Olanda anunţă prelungirea operațiunilor de Poliție Aeriană. Dronele MQ-9 Reaper vor rămâne în România până la 31 decembrie 2027
lithuania.description: Olanda prelungeşte din nou desfăşurarea dronelor sale MQ-9 Reaper care operează din Câmpia Turzii, în România, anunţă, joi, Ambasada Olandei în România. Avioanele fără pilot vor contribui acum la apărarea Flancului Estic al NATO până la 31 decembrie 2027.

lithuania.title: Un elicopter militar rus Mi-8 a încălcat spațiul aerian al Poloniei, într-o nouă incursiune alarmantă
lithuania.description: Un elicopter militar rus de tip Mi-8 a pătruns miercuri în spaţiul aerian polonez în apropierea frontierei cu exclava rusă Kaliningrad, a declarat armata poloneză, acuzând Moscova că doreşte să pună din nou la încercare apărarea ţării, relatează TVPWorld. Într-un incident separat, calea ferată poloneză a fost din nou vizată. Marți seara, două trenuri de marfă au lovit blocuri de beton aflate pe șinele de cale ferată în estul Poloniei, dar niciunul dintre trenuri nu a deraiat și niciunul dintre mecanici nu a fost rănit.

lithuania.title: „Rusia a pierdut deja războiul din Ucraina”, susține președintele unei țări NATO și UE
lithuania.description: Rusia „a pierdut deja” războiul împotriva Ucrainei, a afirmat președintele lituanian Gitanas Nausėda, invocând costurile militare „enorme” suportate de Moscova.

lithuania.title: Avioane de vânătoare poloneze, ridicate pentru a intercepta un aparat de spionaj rus Il-20, în largul coastei Mării Baltice
lithuania.description: Avioanele de vânătoare poloneze au interceptat marți un avion de spionaj rus în largul coastei poloneze a Mării Baltice, a declarat ministrul Apărării, Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz.

lithuania.title: Ce prevede acordul istoric privind Groenlanda: noi baze militare, reguli pentru investiții și promisiuni pentru NATO
lithuania.description: Statele Unite, Danemarca și Groenlanda au semnat, marți, un acord de securitate menit să pună capăt lunilor de tensiuni privind teritoriul danez autonom, după amenințările repetate ale președintelui american Donald Trump de a prelua controlul asupra vastei insule arctice. Reuters a prezentat câteva componente cheie ale acordului, care se adaugă unui pact americano-danez din 1951 privind apărarea Groenlandei, conform unui text publicat de Guvernul danez.

lithuania.title: Nicușor Dan, la CNN: Nu e foarte probabil ca Rusia să atace o țară NATO în următorii unu-doi ani, dar trebuie să fim pregătiți
lithuania.description: Preşedintele Nicuşor Dan, aflat la New York pentru cea de-a 81-a sesiune a Adunării Generale a Organizaţiei Naţiunilor Unite, a declarat că „nu este foarte probabil” ca Rusia să atace o ţară NATO „în următorii unu-doi ani”, dar România trebuie să fie pregătită. De asemenea, şeful statului nu crede că Rusia este cu adevărat pregătită să pună capăt războiului şi apreciază că preşedintele Donald Trump „are dreptate” că Europa trebuie să se implice mai mult în propria apărare.

lithuania.title: NATO învață în țările baltice cum să poarte un război în epoca dronelor: De ce „un tanc pe câmpul de luptă este acum ca un tort”
